scope: Theorem 5.5 of the manuscript “Quaternionic division points on curves in the Siegel threefold” (preprints/Quaternionic-Division-Points-on-Curves-in-the-Siegel-Threefold-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 016 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e11b4b068502ced9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 37-38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a reduced irreducible closed Hodge-generic curve C ⊂ A2 over Q, and let Cν be its normalization. For a fixed nonnegative ample logarithmic height h on the smooth 37 projective completion of Cν and a fixed field of definition K, there are constants C1, C2 > 0 such that every point s ∈ Cν(Q) whose coarse image has full geometric rational endomorphism algebra an indefinite quaternion division algebra over Q satisfies max{2, h(s)} ≤ C1 max{2, [K(s) : K]}C2 . The same assertion holds on the fixed fine-level curves used above, and for a fixed projective height of the coarse points. The constants do not depend on the quaternion algebra, its discriminant, or the target endomorphism order.
